detailed_description: The PDF Compressor optimizes PDF files by implementing advanced stream compression algorithms and object-level deduplication. It employs FlateDecode compression for text-based content, JPEG2000 compression for raster images, and CCITT Group 4 compression for monochrome documents, reducing file size by up to 70% without compromising visual fidelity. The tool intelligently resamples embedded images to a configurable DPI threshold, removes redundant embedded fonts, and compresses XMP metadata streams. Users benefit from maintaining PDF/A compliance while achieving smaller sizes for faster email transfers, cloud storage efficiency, and improved web loading times. It utilizes a two-pass optimization process: first analyzing object structures for redundant data, then applying lossless compression with adjustable quality parameters. The tool supports PDF 1.7 specification compliance, preserves form fields and annotations, and includes an option to downsample color profiles to sRGB for cross-device consistency.
usage_steps: Upload PDF file using the drag-and-drop interface or 'Choose File' button
Adjust compression level using the quality slider (High/Medium/Low presets available)
Enable 'Image Optimization' to activate automatic DPI adjustment (200-high-resolution range)
Toggle 'Remove Embedded Fonts' to substitute with standard font equivalents
Click 'Compress PDF' to initiate the two-stage optimization process
Download optimized file with embedded checksum verification for data integrity
usage_examples: A graphic designer compressing a 25MB portfolio PDF to 8MB for email submission without losing print-quality images
An academic researcher reducing a 500-page thesis PDF from 120MB to 35MB to meet university repository upload requirements
A real estate agent optimizing a 50MB property catalog PDF for Instagram story sharing with interactive form fields intact
A small business owner shrinking 100 invoice PDFs (total 800MB) to 220MB for cost-effective cloud storage backup
